title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: generation speed in the real server, before and after the tuning
setup: Same four loads sent directly to the production router (:8080) before and after the configuration change and one router restart. Weights in the GPU's dedicated memory. 3 code fragments, 1 seed.

later_warm_measurements.note: On 2026-10-25, warm, same loads: 112.6 and 113.5 tok/s on two runs (121.6 on 2026-10-23); the first measurement after a router restart was 82.0 tok/s (cold machine).

other_model_cross_check.model: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt (no MTP head; ngram-mod only)
other_model_cross_check.note: Same loads. Shows that ngram-mod works without an MTP head; reasoning is unchanged (-2%).
